title: El Niño Stresses China’s Power Market With Return to Costly Gas
summary: China’s industrial heartland of Guangdong is being forced to turn back to costlier natural gas to meet rising electricity demand, after the El Niño weather pattern curtailed hydropower and wind output.

title: Pulp Maker Mercer Is Weighing Possible Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
summary: Canadian pulp producer Mercer International Inc. is laying the groundwork for a potential Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: UniSuper CIO Is Not A Skeptic on AI
summary: In a rare BTV interview, John Pearce, Chief Investment Officer of Unisuper says AI industry is closer to the top of the super cycle. In a conversation with Bloomberg's Haidi Stroud-Watts, he talks about what makes some AI business models dodgy and the risks in the space. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Stock Futures Slip After Earnings, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
summary: US equity-index futures fell as mixed earnings from megacaps damped sentiment following this week’s rebound in the artificial intelligence trade. Crude oil climbed as tensions flared in the Middle East.
